decision: User explicitly approved #482 and conditionally #483. This E1 allocation covers only the STOP and the two H0 Reach cards.

native.requires: new allocation, fresh world lease per slot, exact receiver and actual owner, prior read-only rehearsal. Q_STOP requires measured motion and an in-flight reference, real trace STOP, zero subsequent integration/installation, clean reset/process exit. Empty/no-motion fault fails. A failed qualification seals E1/Z1. Score starts independently, no replacements.
native.fault: At entry + 1,000 ticks while the reference is moving, inject one last authenticated gripper command with a 21 ms lifetime within the original 400 ms ceiling and suppress its renewal. Issue the normal outstanding 25-tick grant. On the 2 ms grid expect rejection at entry+1,011; inspect every actual native integration and every install afterward. Abort unqualified if source/actual movement or an in-flight reference is absent at injection.

standing_entry: Measured four feet, no contact and >=15 mm clearance. Continuous 1s TCP drift <=1mm, attitude drift <=0.5deg and base drift <=2mm, before tick 15500. Record the first admitted entry.
fault_motion_witness: Require more than 0.005mm actual in last 50ms and more than 0.01mm pending reference travel over next 100ms, one trace STOP, zero later steps and installs.
